.. change::
    :tags: feature, postgresql

    Added PostgreSQL 18 row level security schema objects and typed DDL elements
    for policy creation and removal together with table enable and force
    state. Added :meth:`_postgresql.PGInspector.get_row_security` and
    :meth:`_postgresql.PGInspector.get_policies` to reflect table flags and
    policy definitions separately, together with bulk reflection methods for
    both.
